title: Ams' Bare Minimum Cobblemon
description: my take on a good cobblemon experience
body:
**IMPORTANT:** Since this uses datapacks, the modpack will come with a world equipped with them upon installing for your convenience. Simply just recreate the world with whatever seed and whatnot and enjoy, no need to mess with datapacks!

Hi. I'm Ams and this is ABMC! A Cobblemon modpack I made and use. Made this to make sharing it with others easier.

Since I play on a potato as of now. This modpack aims to have the bare minimum, as to not degrade performance, while trying to add as much content as possible so things like shaders and other hinderences to performance will not be included.

Here's an overview of what the modpack adds:
1. Performance mods such as Sodium, Ferrite Core, etc
2. QOL mods like Appleskin, JEI and Mousetweaks
3. Utility mods like NotEnoughCrashes
4. Aesthetic mods and resource packs such as 3d Skin Layers and Fresh Animations.
5. Cobblemon addons such as Mega Showdown, Journey mounts and Alpha Project.

and a heck ton more!
